cards.card_text: Then he says, "His anger has torn me and opposed me; He gnashes His teeth at me."
cards.verse_text: His anger has torn me and opposed me; He gnashes His teeth at me.
cards.snippet: His anger has torn me and opposed me; He gnashes His teeth at me.

cards.card_text: True or false: David says his attackers gnashed their teeth at him like godless jesters at a feast.
cards.verse_text: Like godless jesters at a feast, they gnashed their teeth at me.
cards.snippet: Like godless jesters at a feast, they gnashed their teeth at me.

cards.card_text: Now David shows what the wicked are up to: they scheme against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them.
cards.verse_text: The wicked scheme against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them,
cards.snippet: The wicked scheme against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them,

cards.card_text: He will be grieved and gnash his teeth He will change his ways and give He will laugh and walk away
cards.verse_text: The wicked man will see and be grieved; he will gnash his teeth and waste away; the desires of the wicked will perish.
cards.snippet: The wicked man will see and be grieved; he will gnash his teeth and waste away; the desires of the wicked will perish.

cards.card_text: Whenever the spirit seizes the boy, it throws him to the ground, and he foams at the mouth, gnashes his teeth and becomes rigid.
cards.verse_text: He foams at the mouth, gnashes his teeth, and becomes rigid.
cards.snippet: He foams at the mouth, gnashes his teeth, and becomes rigid.

cards.card_text: On hearing this, the members of the Sanhedrin are enraged, and they gnash their teeth at Stephen.
cards.verse_text: On hearing this, the members of the Sanhedrin were enraged, and they gnashed their teeth at him.
cards.snippet: On hearing this, the members of the Sanhedrin were enraged, and they gnashed their teeth at him.
